test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT about properties of ionic compounds?

options.text: Ionic compounds are solids because of the weak force of attractions between positive and negative ions.
Ionic compounds have high melting and boiling points.
Ionic compounds are generally brittle and break into pieces when pressure is applied.
Electrovalent compounds are generally soluble in water and insoluble in petrol.

solution:
The correct answer is __**option 1**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ionic compounds are solids because of the strong electrostatic forces of attraction between positive (cations) and negative (anions) ions, not weak forces. 
 
• These strong forces result in a rigid lattice structure, making ionic compounds solid at room temperature.
 
• So this statement is incorrect.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ionic compounds have high melting and boiling points due to the strong electrostatic forces that require a significant amount of energy to overcome.
 
• Ionic compounds are brittle because applying pressure shifts the alignment of ions, causing like charges to repel each other, leading to the breaking of the crystal structure.
 
• Ionic (electrovalent) compounds are generally soluble in polar solvents like water because water's polarity helps separate the ions. However, they are insoluble in non-polar solvents like petrol.
